name: lfu_cache
prompt: Create solution.py defining class LFUCache(capacity) with get(key) -> value or -1, and put(key, value). Every get of an existing key and every put counts as one use of that key; a brand-new key starts with 1 use (its put). When putting a NEW key into a full cache, first evict the key with the FEWEST uses; if several tie, evict the least recently used among them. Putting an existing key updates its value, counts as a use, and never evicts. A capacity of 0 (or less) stores nothing: put does nothing and get returns -1. A missing-key get changes nothing. Verify it by running code, then call finish.
